# Deny-by-default management filter (mgmt-acl mode strict; Junos only).
# The filter accepts every protocol from the sources of the mgmt-acl list (an entry with
# services keeps only those) and has no default-accept term: the implicit discard at the
# end of a Junos filter drops the rest.
# Once the filter is applied to lo0, these stop reaching the routing engine:
#   - routing protocols carried over IP from neighbours that are not in the list: BGP, OSPF, LDP, VRRP, BFD
#     (IS-IS is not carried over IP: a family inet filter on lo0 does not see it, so it is neither stopped nor permitted)
#   - replies from servers that are not in the list: TACACS+ and RADIUS (the replies of the server this
#     walkthrough names are accepted), NTP, DNS
#   - NTP, syslog and DHCP from hosts that are not in the list
#   - SNMP from sources outside the list (the SNMP clients of Step 5 still poll)
#   - every other protocol (ping, traceroute) from sources outside the list
# permit-mgmt starts with the address tacctl reaches the device from.
# Add each neighbour and server the device needs to the permit list this scope renders from first
# ('tacctl scope mgmt-acl lab list' says which): the first entry of the scope's own list replaces
# the global list for this scope, so add the global entries to it too.
# Keep a console session open while you apply it, and commit with 'commit confirmed'.
# These 'set firewall' lines define the filter in the candidate config.
# Activate it by uncommenting the 'set interfaces lo0 …' line below
# after reviewing.
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from source-address 192.0.2.1/32
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from source-address 10.0.0.0/8
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from source-address 10.1.0.0/16
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt then accept
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp from source-address 192.0.2.1/32
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp from source-address 198.51.100.0/24
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp from protocol udp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp from destination-port snmp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp then accept
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-snmp from protocol udp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-snmp from destination-port snmp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-snmp then log
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-snmp then discard
# udp port 161 (SNMP, Step 5) is accepted from the SNMP clients and from the sources the terms above accept
# for it, and refused from every other source (deny-snmp logs it).
#
# Apply (review first):
# set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet filter input MGMT-ACL
